name: zrndr_span_occlusion_test_column_visibility
description: zRndr_SpanOcclusion::TestColumnVisibility tests whether the pending span allocation remains visible against a column's current occlusion spans.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because dense x87 span-depth comparisons and the copied local span still keep HLIL verbose.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this column-visibility helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr span-occlusion pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x491dd0 validates initial visible out-param clearing, lookup through the span-column head table, early visible exits for empty or disjoint spans, copied current-span locals, depth-bias rejection checks, the call to TestSpanDepthOrderPair, candidate-range trimming, and final visibility writes.
The native column-visibility smoke verifies empty/disjoint visible paths, fully occluded spans, partial visibility after trimming, and candidate-in-front behavior.
